kultivator.screen.help.urat_roh.title: Spirit Veins and Closed-Door Cultivation
kultivator.screen.help.urat_roh: Every region of 4×4 chunks rests on a spirit vein: Great (density up to 200%), Rich (140%), normal (100%) or Thin (60%). Meditation drains the vein and it refills by itself in about 42 minutes. Meditation gives a realm base rate (much higher from Deity Transformation) × site × formation × spirit-stone fuel (together at most ×5) × density. Spirit stones in the offhand burn as fuel (Low ×1.5 every 30 s, Mid ×2, High ×2.5, Supreme ×3) and halve the drain; at a full bottleneck their gain becomes Stored Qi. Unbroken meditation earns a seclusion stack every 5 minutes (+5% each, up to +25%) and after 30 minutes raises the enlightenment chance ×1.5. A Great or Heavenly qi formation keeps the density from falling below 30% or 45%. Cave Abode: meditate on a qi formation seat inside an active protective formation and use /kultivasi gua tetapkan; within 6 blocks the drain halves, enlightenment rises and short breaks keep your seclusion. The Spirit Vein Compass (compass + amethyst shard + gold ingot + glow berries) points at the nearest Great or Rich vein. Sources: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 391, 520, 803, 1347; RMJ: Immortal Realm ch. 1142; inspired by Martial World ch. 879, I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 25 and the Source Masters of Shrouding the Heavens; Renegade Immortal ch. 216.
kultivator.screen.help.anugerah.title: Ascension Boons, Foundation and Stars
kultivator.screen.help.anugerah: Each Immortal Ascension layer opens Immortal meridians and a boon: Immortal Breath, Light Step, Jade Skin, Qi Sea, Heaven's Reach, Immortal Meridians, Unbroken Soul (once per game day a killing blow leaves you at 1 health), Clear Mind and Door of Immortality; True Immortals have all nine. Strengthen Foundation (/kultivasi fondasi perkokoh, meditating on a qi formation of tier 2+) spends Stored Qi in a 30 s ritual to raise your lowest breakthrough quality: Cracked→Normal always, Normal→Perfect 60%, Perfect→Heavenly 25%, a failure gives half back. At True Immortal Peak every gain becomes Immortal Qi: condense it into endless Immortal Stars (/kultivasi bintang padatkan [semua]), each +2 health, +1% qi and stronger techniques; ★9 and ★18 open God Gates I and II. When a Qi Deviation ends at a bottleneck, Stored Qi flows back into the bar. Sources: I Shall Seal the Heavens Book 6 ch. 963–983 and Book 2 ch. 134; ch. 76 and 100; Battle Through the Heavens (Dou star grades); inspired by the Ancient God stars of Renegade Immortal ch. ~1157–1159.
